source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U09: Apply sub-sale/title-document qualifications,resale conditions and personal remedies

payload.title: A right over goods and a personal claim can coexist
payload.core_explanation_md:
An unpaid seller may have the described rights against the goods and separate claims for price,damages or interest,depending on their conditions. The original buyer further sale or pledge also requires the statutory qualification for good-faith,value and relevant title-document transfers;do not state either that every later transfer defeats the seller or that none ever can.

Resale needs its actual ground and process,such as the described perishable-goods or notice route. Notice can affect damages and profit treatment. A later buyer title question is distinct from what the original parties owe between themselves. Keep each claim and its legal basis separate rather than assuming resale automatically settles every amount.

self_check.prompt_text: Does resale alone determine all damages and surplus consequences?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The grounds,notice and applicable rules matter.

payload.stem_md: A collateral review says an original buyer later pledge can never affect unpaid-seller rights under any circumstances. What qualification must be checked?

options.text_md: The statutory good-faith,value and title-document transfer conditions
options.explanation_md: The source describes a qualified exception.

options.text_md: Only whether the later lender has a larger office
A rule that every transfer always defeats the seller
options.explanation_md: That opposite absolute statement is also wrong.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source describes a qualified exception.

payload.stem_md: The seller resells and claims every loss without examining whether the required notice was given. Which analysis remains?

options.text_md: The buyer must automatically receive every future seller profit
options.explanation_md: Consequences depend on the applicable route.

options.text_md: The resale ground,notice and resulting damages/profit rules
options.explanation_md: A sale event alone does not establish all inter-party remedies.
That does not resolve notice compliance.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A sale event alone does not establish all inter-party remedies.
